# Mark Le Chevalier

Mark Le Chevalier has participated in 1 election since 2002:

- [**2022 Connétables Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/mark-le-chevalier#e49)

  Not elected.

  - [2022 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2022/mark-william-le-chevalier/)
  - [2022 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kKsR93kdpWQ)
  - [2022 Full Manifesto](https://www.facebook.com/Vote.LeChevalier/photos/pcb.121405407224441/121405250557790)

Mark Le Chevalier has declared his intention to stand in the upcoming [2026 Connétables Election](https://flow.je/elections/2026) in [St Helier](https://flow.je/elections/st-helier). \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/04/21/list-of-contenders-for-vacant-st-helier-constable-position-grows-to-four/)\]

Links for Mark Le Chevalier:

- Facebook : [@Vote.LeChevalier](https://www.facebook.com/Vote.LeChevalier)
